# Agustin Diaz-Cano - Software Engineer

## About

Software Engineer | Python Developer with 4+ years of experience in software development, specializing in AI/ML and Backend Development (Python).

I'm currently pursuing an M.Sc. in Systems Engineering at UTN, focused on Artificial Intelligence and Data Analysis. My technical focus is building backend architectures that integrate GenAI in production-realistic conditions, not just prototypes. I'm developing projects with Python, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to explore LLM orchestration and AI agent design.

Previously, Sole QA Owner and quality authority for Grupo GDU's e-commerce platforms. Responsible for the entire quality strategy of web and mobile across multiple high-traffic sites, covering a multi-million dollar online channel with hundreds of thousands of users. Held full Go/No-Go authority on production releases with no dedicated QA team. During my tenure, the platforms—previously unranked—achieved nominations for the eCommerce Awards Uruguay in 2024 and 2025.

Transitioned from zero coding background in the pre-AI era. Wrote my first line of code in October 2020, received a job offer on May 14, 2021, and shipped my first production PR in June 2021 at an international fintech. Participated in more than 10 projects that reached production.

In game development, I created full modifications for the Men of War series as a solo developer, reaching over 200,000 downloads. Only a small percentage of Steam games, mods, and mobile apps (typically under 2-5%, and often closer to 1% for the 100k threshold) ever reach that level of adoption.

[View Full Profile](https://www.agustindiazcano.com/profile)

## Projects
[View All Projects](https://www.agustindiazcano.com/projects)

- **MCP Transactional Agent (2026)**: Intelligent agentic system using LLMs.
- **Algorithmic Trading Engine (2025)**: Automated high-performance system for low latency trades.
- **Alien Survival (2025)**: Unity-based survival game against alien swarms.
- **AI & ML Research (2024)**: Physics simulations and neural networks experiments.
- **Astrophysics Data Simulations (2023)**: Robust simulations modeling complex astrophysics systems.
- **LATAM E-commerce Ecosystem (2022)**: Scalable and localized e-commerce solution handling complex gateways.
- **InsurTech Quoting Engine (2021)**: Real-time insurance premium quoting engine.
- **Crypto Ethereum Mining Rig (2017)**: Assembled and configured a rig for Ethereum mining in the early adoption era. [View Repository](https://github.com/agustindiazcano/eth-mining-infrastructure-2017)
- **Game Dev: Modding Ecosystem (2010)**: 220,000+ Downloads across Men of War series (solo creator, no marketing budget, no pre-existing audience).
    - [Men of War Zombie Mod Main (+113k Downloads)](https://www.moddb.com/mods/zombie-mod5)
    - [Men of War Zombie Mod Assault (+84k Downloads)](https://www.moddb.com/mods/men-of-war-zombie-mod)
    - [Men of War HD Mod (20k Downloads)](https://www.moddb.com/mods/hd-mod)
    - [Zombie Mod Men of War Grokipedia](https://grokipedia.com/page/Zombie_Mod_Men_of_War)

    **Context (actual rarity)**:  
    - Only ~1–2% of Steam games ever reach 100,000+ lifetime units.  
    - On Google Play, ~75% of newly launched apps never exceed 1,000 downloads, and only ~2% surpass 100,000.  
    - On the App Store (iOS), ~92–93% of apps show effectively zero measurable downloads.  
    - The majority of mid-size company apps (and many corporate products) never reach 200k organic downloads.  
    Achieving 220k+ downloads as a solo creator is a long-tail outcome that 98–99% of software engineers never accomplish independently in their entire careers.

    Sources:  
    - Steam: https://www.steampageanalyzer.com/blog/average-steam-game-sales · https://gamalytic.com/years · https://x.com/WladMarhulets/status/1920197804275667122  
    - Android: https://www.appbrain.com/stats/android-app-downloads · https://www.statista.com/statistics/269884/android-app-downloads/ · https://x.com/Similarweb/status/2066064899428483162  
    - iOS: https://getappniche.com/answers/how-many-downloads-is-good

### Knowledge-Based Systems & Fuzzy Logic Project
**Course**: Intelligent Data Exploitation, UTN MSc (November 2024)
An Artificial Intelligence project applying classical knowledge-based systems methodology (METHONTOLOGY), rule-based inference, and fuzzy logic to reduce false positives in bug report triage for an e-commerce platform. Contributed as the domain expert consulted during the knowledge acquisition process.
